name: Offtake statement variance check
summary: When a buyer's offtake statement differs from the energy sales ledger, the settlement analyst gets one comparison: volumes, periods, prices and adjustments set against the metered-volume export and the agreed price inputs, each discrepancy traced to its source. Nothing is disputed or adjusted.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of the work, written from how settlement analysts check a buyer's statement against the sales ledger, the meter data and the agreed prices. No third-party text.
